role: Creates the texture resource and copies every subresource record; record flag bit 1 selects surface-major indexing

name: TextureSubresourceCopy
role: Copies one 0x18-byte subresource record into the destination

name: TextureChunkLevelCount
role: Returns the chunk header's +0x04 level count

name: TextureResourceDesc
role: Fills the D3D12 resource desc: kinds 0/1 1D, 2..7 2D, 8 3D; cube kinds 6/7 layers*6

name: TextureBaseMips
role: Returns descriptor bits 51..54 (base_mips)

name: TextureDepthAtLevel
role: Depth at a mip level, clamped at 1

name: TextureHeightAtLevel
role: Height at a mip level: max(height >> level, 1)

name: TextureWidthAtLevel
role: Width at a mip level: max(width >> level, 1)

name: TextureResourceKind
role: Descriptor flags to resource kind 0..6 (bit 6 selects the variant)

name: TextureSubresourceCount
role: Total subresources: mips * arrays * 6 for cube kinds

name: TextureSubresourceIndex
role: D3D12 subresource index: (array*faces + face)*mip_count + mip

name: TextureLevelPitch
role: Fills per-level row pitch, slice pitch and stored size (block ceil)

name: TextureChunkData
role: Chunk data pointer: chunk + header_size (+0x0c)

name: TextureChunkFirstFromSmallest
role: Returns the chunk header's +0x00 first_from_smallest

name: TextureChunkImageSize
role: Returns the chunk header's +0x08 image_size
